methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia Tech researchers look to AI to ease difficult workplace conversations
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech developing AI tools for workplace communication signals university-driven capability building that could distribute practical AI fluency beyond traditional tech hubs, though impact depends on whether SMEs across regions actually adopt the tooling.

signals.title: RiverStreet Networks removed from multiple broadband deployment projects in rural Virginia after years of delays
signals.signal_reading: Broadband deployment failure affecting 30,000+ potential customers in rural Virginia directly undermines infrastructure prerequisites for distributed AI adoption, reinforcing the concentration of capability in already-connected metro corridors.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in building deep AI leadership capacity outside NoVA-Richmond axis, though geographic impact depends on whether graduates stay regionally or migrate to metro opportunities.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops explicitly targeting the technology gap in Hampton Roads signals grassroots distribution efforts, but workshop format suggests shallow platform-literacy rather than deep technical capability building.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates resources and institutional backing in the Richmond metro hub, deepening regional capability but requiring deliberate outreach mechanisms to avoid reinforcing capital-region concentration patterns.
